answer: The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Before the stamp comes 13 letters of reference, each one priced at £12, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One name, one proof, one entry: Weighed sausage maker cooperage writ enforces it, and a writ makers hold after workshop checks is how the check runs. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The tally keeps dune. umber stays on the record. The orchard is checked, not assumed.
